I’ve bought 2 budgies from here before and never had a problem. It was a man who helped me these 2 times. I bought another budgie a couple of weeks ago after one of my budgies had died (after having him for years) so my other budgie wouldn’t miss her mate. I was helped out by a lady who was so rude. She’s not careful with the pets. She dropped the bird after she placed it in the bag. I specifically asked her for a male budgie so my other bird will have a new mate. She checked the budgie and gave me an awkward smile before placing the bird inside the bag. I assumed she smiled like that because the bird was a little dirty and a missing toe. I was suspicious of the bird’s sex since my female budgie didn’t care for it so I took it to the vet just to find out that the bird was a female. The lady knew she sold me a female bird and didn’t bother to say anything. Not sure why she’s working there if obviously so many other reviews have complained about her.
